options.description: Add a browser test that rebuilds the room under an open tab and expects drawn diagrams. No extra time from you; catches only what a test was written for.
options.label: Automated test only (Recommended)

options.description: A merge that rebuilds the room marks its live proofs as needing your look again after landing. Catches more; costs you one look per rebuild.
options.label: Re-show after a rebuild

options.description: Proofs stay one-time; you find the next one in use.
options.label: Leave as is

payload.question: The study room broke unnoticed because a proof, once shown, counts forever even after the room is rebuilt. What should catch that next time?
